description: Architectural rules ensuring domain isolation, dependency inversion, and strict boundary separation.

rules.name: Domain Independence from Frameworks & Infra
rules.description: The Domain layer (Entities and Use Cases) must not import or depend on infrastructure libraries, ORMs, web frameworks, or third-party SDKs.
rules.rationale: The business core must remain framework-agnostic, ensuring longevity, maintainability, and effortless unit testing without heavy mocks.
rules.remediation: Invert dependencies by declaring interfaces (Ports/Contracts) in the Domain layer and implementing them in Infrastructure (Adapters).

rules.name: Strict Inward Dependency Rule
rules.description: Code dependencies must point exclusively inward towards higher-level business rules.
rules.rationale: Inner layers must have zero awareness of outer layers (e.g., Entities do not know UseCases, UseCases do not know Controllers).
rules.remediation: Remove direct outer layer imports and apply dependency injection using interfaces.

rules.name: Boundary DTOs and Data Transfer Isolation
rules.description: Do not expose raw ORM/database entities directly in HTTP responses or external API contracts.
rules.rationale: Prevents database schema leaks and unintended tight coupling between API consumers and internal entity implementations.
rules.remediation: Map domain entities to dedicated DTOs or ViewModels before returning them to consumers.
